verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's evidence pack covers PR review, chat, self-hosting, and CLI features, but there is no documentation of a sandbox/staging environment where an AI-native user could test CodeRabbit's agentic actions without touching production data. If anything, community evidence (coderabbit-comm-4) describes an incident where CodeRabbit's own review agent ran against a live production system rather than an isolated sandbox, undercutting any implicit claim of safe test isolation.
